text: On February 26, 2026, the Etobicoke York Panel of the Committee of Adjustment approved an application for a minor variance, subject to the conditions, to permit a new six-storey mixed-use building with ten residential units and retail on `the ground floor on the lands municipally known as 2455 St. Clair Avenue West (Application No: A0400/25EYK). As per the Community Planning staff’s recommendation, the Committee of Adjustment Decision included a condition that, due to the site's proximity to the rail yard and rail facilities, a Rail Noise and Vibration Impact Study and Air Quality Study shall be completed by a certified professional engineer and peer-reviewed by a third-party to identify any adverse effects from noise, vibration, and emissions, and required mitigation to prevent or mitigate same. A Rail Noise and Vibration Impact Study and Air Quality Addendum Letter were prepared in…

City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council classify 2455 St. Clair Avenue West as a Class 4 Noise Area pursuant to Publication NPC-300 (Environmental Noise Guideline - Stationary and Transportation Sources - Approval and Planning). 2. City Council forward a copy of the City Council Decision to the Ministry of Environment, Conservation and Parks.
